additional_reporting: input and response/EOS training tokens separately
termination, invalid control tokens, cap hit, output length
raw causal functional results, raw/FIM line exact results
source parse regression where source reconstruction and parser are available
first and last sixteen update losses plus skipped/overflow counts
interpretation_rules: Report gains, losses and separate denominators.
No universal quality claim from exact source reconstruction.
Equal exposures and matched length bins are approximate compute control; report actual tokens and wall-time.
If repetition helps but distinct states do not, repeat optimization is promising on this task, not proof of a universal compute bottleneck.
If distinct states outperform repetition, broader data is the stronger tested tradeoff.
If neither improves, preserve stable model; report intervals, do not call nonsignificance equivalence.
primary_metric: exact_and_terminated on all new development states, same complete fixture for both variants

strata.target_content: punctuation-only if all target characters are whitespace or one of []{}(),;:. Other targets are content-bearing by this lexical rule. This is descriptive, not a functional-quality label.
